summary: You build the knowledge base the assistant will answer from: 20 documents (6 manuals, 7 FAQs, 7 error codes) and a typed loader. A test holds the promise of 20, and a missing folder is turned from a silent 0 into a clear error.
goal: Build a 20-document knowledge base and a loader that returns typed Documents, with a test.

items.text: Part A: write down the folders, the Document fields and what a doc_id looks like
Part B: get the 20 Markdown files into data/kb, from the starter pack or your own, and read each one
Part C: write the loader and see 20 {'manual': 6, 'faq': 7, 'error': 7}
Part D: write two tests and see 2 passed
Part E: load a wrong folder, see the silent 0, make it an error and add a third test
Part F: add the README section, commit and push
Play the Knowledge Base Check game to the end and see your score
